dau_market_food_snapshot_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { trade_category_unfulfilled_need = { target = trade_good_category:trade_category_cereals value > 0 } }
        scope:dau_market_anchor = {
            set_variable = dau_market_food_shortage
            add_to_variable_list = { name = dau_market_requested_categories target = trade_good_category:trade_category_cereals }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { trade_category_unfulfilled_need = { target = trade_good_category:trade_category_meat value > 0 } }
        scope:dau_market_anchor = {
            set_variable = dau_market_food_shortage
            add_to_variable_list = { name = dau_market_requested_categories target = trade_good_category:trade_category_meat }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { trade_good_unfulfilled_need = { target = trade_good_type:trade_good_fish value > 0 } }
        scope:dau_market_anchor = {
            set_variable = dau_market_food_shortage
            add_to_variable_list = { name = dau_market_requested_goods target = trade_good_type:trade_good_fish }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { trade_good_unfulfilled_need = { target = trade_good_type:trade_good_fruit value > 0 } }
        scope:dau_market_anchor = {
            set_variable = dau_market_food_shortage
            add_to_variable_list = { name = dau_market_requested_goods target = trade_good_type:trade_good_fruit }
        }
    }
}
